title: Affine weakly contractible covering family on the pro-etale site
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Every object $U$ of this site admits a covering family $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ in which each $U_i$ is affine and weakly contractible for the full site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Here weakly contractible means that for every epimorphism $F\to G$ of sheaves of sets on this site, $F(U_i)\to G(U_i)$ is surjective.
